validation.error_budgets: Existing helper F32 rel6e-6+abs2e-6; F16 rel.001+abs2e-7; BF16 rel.008+abs2e-7; weak-probability abs.002. No budget relaxed. Baseline fails general F16 and weak-probability tests; candidate passes.

space.measurement: One fresh process per variant, matched ordinary public Context::prepare/create_invocation/bind/submit/wait. Ready inputs and cold prepare/bind precede clear_cache/reset_peak. No timing. MLX global allocator active/peak/cache, not process RSS/whole-device VRAM nor exact provider-private bytes. Caller inputs/output are separately listed. All 1048576 outputs checked against 1.25 with existing abs.002 budget.
space.source_boundary: Space comparison uses apple_tensor.space-measured-candidate.cc. Final candidate adds B>0 and KV>0 force guards only; measured B1/KV1024 follows the identical lowering path. Final candidate was freshly compiled and its existing four tests rerun PASS; allocation experiment was not repeated.

diagnostics_and_failed_runs_retained: Initial baseline SIGSEGV was harness access to an unevaluated transpose. Fixed by contiguous(transpose), explicit eval/synchronize/wait before host data read. Both variants then exit normally. Exact initial harness and force-all-dtype source retained in initial-sources.tar.
Initial F32 D192 force experiment rejected by Metal: native full kernel requests 40448 bytes threadgroup vs device 32768. F32 force is excluded from product; no metallib/native patch.
Initial narrow fused Boolean fully masked rows differ from original fallback. All explicit masks now statically retain fallback, without host mask-value inspection.

Finite additive fused exploratory cases passed, but this is not the final product domain. A later no-mask-only run failed its exploratory F16 additive FP64 budget because original fallback already has that rounding error; this unsupported new-precision claim was removed from the regression, F32 additive behavior remains checked. Logs retained.

Initial space baseline failed an overstrict exact-1.25 assertion (observed max abs .0009765625). Repeated matched old/new under existing .002 numeric budget pass, logs retained. No product precision threshold changed.
